name: Product Demo + Narration
description: Uses the brand's own captured product screenshots as the hero footage rather than generating fake UI, with narration spoken by the video model and a generated end card. The right template when the product is software and the real UI is the proof.

promise.description: The single mechanical claim the demo proves, e.g. 'one form, five feeds'.

steps.description: 2-3 steps the viewer sees happen, as a list of strings.

nodes.system: You write demo narration for 9:16 video. You describe what is happening on screen in the fewest possible words. No feature lists, no 'introducing'.

schema.demo_line: <=18 words, spoken over the product shot
schema.cta_line: <=12 words, spoken over the end card
schema.end_card_prompt: text-to-image prompt for the end card

nodes.prompt: Slow parallax push-in on the interface with subtle depth, a cursor gliding between elements. A warm, plain-spoken narrator says: "{{script.demo_line}}". Vertical 9:16, clean screen-recording feel, no added text on screen.
nodes.negative_prompt: watermark, text overlay, subtitles, distorted UI, garbled interface text, cinematic colour grade

nodes.prompt:
{{script.end_card_prompt}}

Clean vertical 9:16 composition, flat brand colours, generous negative space in the lower third, no lettering.
nodes.negative_prompt: text, lettering, watermark, logos, busy detail

nodes.prompt: Very slow zoom on the held end card, minimal motion. The same narrator says: "{{script.cta_line}}". Vertical 9:16.
